industry.why: Neutral at industry level, carried, with the case for Overweight stronger than at any time since the row was set and still not taken. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-11-06 against 2026-09-04, not week on week: A now, C prior: healthcare is the defensive the market is paying for, with Medtech capital goods A, Pharma/biotech B, Medtech consumables B and Pharma manufacturing services B. Component 1 regime, 6-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its high, now present in Europe's own prices: the STOXX Europe 600 0.9% from its 52-week high with the share of stocks above the 100, 150 and 200-day averages at or below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows, breadth recovering for a second week; the causes, inflation, rates, yields, credit and the consumer, unread this week because the strategist and newsletter files did not reach the pack, so the credit-and-cost-of-debt read of 30-Oct-26 with the US ten-year above 5% is held one week stale; sources present 2026-W45, headline-only) pays large, proven, cash-yielding cases, which is the Pharma/biotech row (B) and Hospitals (B). Held at C because the industry letter adds the same 30% weight to clinical-stage biotech (D, relative strength F) and capex-cyclical medical equipment as to large pharma, no source spoke to pharmaceuticals against medical technology this week, and eleven of the top 40 on the starting score are already healthcare names. Counter-case for B: two readings two months apart at A with the regime's rotation confirmed on every window; for D: a crowded destination. To B if a source carries a healthcare read with the industry's relative strength holding A or B.

sector.why: Neutral. Proven consumables fit Component 1 regime (rates-led late cycle: Richard's view 16-Sep-26, rates and yields rising, inflation high, consumer confidence low, downside skew; sources absent), but relative strength F now from D prior disagrees. Held Neutral.

geography.why: Neutral, carried. No Swedish survey and no Riksbank reading reached the pack this week, so the condition for B (a confidence print at or above normal with the Riksbank on hold) could not be tested; the only Swedish data point is food retail volumes up 5.3% in September after a value-added tax cut (Danske, 18 Oct), which is a sector fact, not a country view. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43). Four live holdings are Swedish (Avanza 0.50%, Hexatronic 4.95%, Sdiptech 5.05%, Xvivo 5.05%, 15.55 points), judged in component 4 and in amendment 10. Relative strength is not graded by country.

adds.criterion: The rules: no sell signal from the six Sell Criteria

bullets.text: Three tests give sell signals: the relative 200D MA (6-Nov), the breadth test and relative price below its 52W high (30-Oct).
With a sell signal on, the rules block an add to Xvivo; the 30% fall test has also triggered both tranches.

bullets.text: The book shows Xvivo at 3.68% of capital now against the 6.68% limit, leaving 3.00%; at the UBS weight (2.06%) the room is 4.62%.
Either way there is room for at least one 1.67% tranche, but the sell signals block an add.
The book corrected for your 4-Nov sale, which changes the room, not the answer.

The Master Dashboard reads pulling back 0 of 4 tests, basing 0 of 4, a healthy retest possible (3 of 6, no MA retested), a volatility contraction pattern 0 of 4.
The SEK 193 shelf holding for several weeks, then a close above the 20D MA (SEK 210.58) on volume, would make it basing.

bullets.text: Absent: Xvivo has closed below its absolute 200D MA for 34 sessions since 24-Sep, 16.2% below it on 10-Nov.
Every MA from the 20D up fell over five sessions, and four of the six trend-health tests fail.
Xvivo closing back above its absolute 200D MA (SEK 243.42), 19.3% higher, with that MA turning up again.

adds.criterion: Your add trigger: a broadening of the case (momentum rising in guidance, sell-side estimates, technicals or peers)

Technicals bounced but Stock RS is 12; the peers have risen 9.5% to 29.6% over the month without Xvivo.
FY2027 cuts stopping, Net Upgrade Breadth back to zero or above, and Xvivo's Stock RS turning up with its sector.
On 10-Nov you wrote "Stock continues to lag an up market"; on 4-Nov, "I need to reduce again to zero soon".
Your notes look to exit, not add; your 28-Oct condition for an add, "no company-specific negative newsflow", does not hold.

defs.atr: average true range: each day's high to low, stretched to the previous close on a gap, as a % of the previous close; L5D the last 5 sessions, L1M and L3M the last 30 and 91 calendar days
defs.top_half: a close above the midpoint of the day's high-low range; an up day closes at or above the previous close; days with no range are left out
